_sources.customer: CUST04754 = the app's default demo persona 'Aino' (app/shared/personas.ts)
_sources.map: ~/data/global/map.json (GET /api/global/map): ids, x, y (UMAP of 23 behaviour features, normalised 0-1), tribe (KMeans k=5); tribes from tribes.json (names, shares)
_sources.map.z: third axis = each customer's own savings rate, last 12 months (~/data/features/features.parquet, window y2, column savings_rate, a fraction; zLo/zHi and aino.savingsRate in %), shown on a 0-1 scale between the population's 1st and 99th percentile (zLo..zHi %, values outside clipped to the ends; the model itself clips its features at p1/p99)
_sources.aino: ~/data/ml/profile/CUST04754.json (GET /api/ml/profile/CUST04754): map.x/y, tribe.name (the app's Money Map card)
_sources.twins: Aino's 100 money twins recomputed with the exact matching of ml/a_twins.py build(); verified against ~/data/ml/twins/CUST04754.json (group sizes 33/33/34 and median distance match). twinIdx = index into the map arrays, twinGroup 0 built / 1 held / 2 slipped, ordered nearest first. Their map points are their current (last-12-month) positions; they were matched on their behaviour a year earlier.
_sources.futures: ~/data/ml/twins/CUST04754.json groups[built|slipped].path[].p50 (median balance change month 0..12, euros scaled to Aino's income) and bufferChange; the app's Two Futures card shows built vs slipped
_sources.forecast: ~/data/ml/forecast/CUST04754.json (GET /api/ml/forecast/CUST04754) fan[] days 0..nextPayday.daysAway+1 as the app's ForecastChart (fanToPayday) draws it: p10/p50/p90 balance; balance, nextPayday, overdraftProbToPayday
_sources.risk: ~/data/ml/risk/CUST04754.json (GET /api/ml/risk/CUST04754): probability, baseRate, horizonDays, drivers (direction 'raises', top 3, as the app's RiskDrivers shows)
_sources.peers: ~/data/global/peers.json byAgeBand['18-24'][metric].p50 vs profile.features[metric] (the app's peer benchmarks)
_sources.risk.short: drivers[].short/value = our shortened wording of the model's own driver label (drivers[].label) and display value, for the screen
_sources.forecast.onScreen: labels at the day before payday (index paydayDay-1, 2026-10-14): p50 72, p10 -240, p90 266, as the app's fan tooltip shows that day
